pinned_spec_facts.fact: workspace separates immutable raw traces, persistent wiki knowledge, and active skills
wiki patterns consolidate raw traces and may be created or updated with evidence
skill PURPOSE.md maps skills back to motivating wiki patterns
rejected skill changes are rolled back while the wiki is retained
published Wiki Maintainer output contract requires pattern content, index, and log updates but does not require source trace identifiers

scope_note: The source does not specify later revocation/correction standing for already-consolidated raw experience; that is the external composition tested here.

source.title: WikiSkill: Compiling Agent Experience into Persistent Knowledge for Skill Evolution
